name: zmath_project_point_and_clamp_to_screen_clip
description: zMath::ProjectPointAndClampToScreenClip transforms a point by camera scratch B, projects it to screen coordinates, clamps screen edges, and reports the edge/behind-screen code.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this projection helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath projection source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The native smoke covers inside-frustum projection, left-edge clamp, top/bottom clamps, and the behind-near-plane projection path.
